name: Renato Gallina
summary: In Stormwind's Trade District, Renato Gallina calls travelers toward his family's winery.

sections.title: Voice of the Gallina Winery
sections.body: Renato Gallina calls to passers-by among the Trade District stalls, proclaiming his family's vintages the finest in Stormwind. The Gallina family runs a winery along the Canals, and Renato promotes it with pamphlets. Travelers can bring one to his sister Suzetta at the shop for a free bottle of wine.

faq.answer: Renato Gallina is a human barker in Stormwind City's Trade District. He belongs to the Gallina family and promotes their winery to locals and visiting travelers.

faq.q: Where is the Gallina Winery located?
faq.answer: The Gallina Winery is along the Canals of Stormwind City, just off the main commercial quarters.

faq.q: What does Renato ask adventurers to do?
faq.answer: Renato gives travelers a pamphlet for his family's wine shop and asks them to bring it to his sister, Suzetta Gallina, at the winery along the Canals. The pamphlet earns them a free bottle of wine.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler arriving in the capital, you can see Renato at work promoting Stormwind's local commerce and domestic trades.
